Vocab: Each token ID and its bytes.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Parses a [JSON Schema](https://github.com/IsaacBreen/glrmask/blob/main/GUIDE.md#grammar-formats), given as JSON text or a dict.
Grammar.compile: Compiles the grammar into a constraint.
Module.precompile: Compiles what it can now, even with externs unbound. Further compilation must use the same `vocab`.
Module.compile: Finishes compiling the module into a constraint.
Module.load: May fail if saved by a different GLRMask version.
Constraint.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits: the largest token ID in the constraint (including special and end tokens) plus one, or zero if there are no token IDs.
Constraint.load: May fail if saved by a different GLRMask version. Fails if `vocab` differs from the one it was compiled with.
ConstraintState.mask: Packed uint32 words: token i is bit i % 32 of word i // 32.
ConstraintState.fill_mask: Like `mask()`, but writes the words into `bitmask`. May release the GIL.
ConstraintState.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits: the largest token ID in the constraint (including special and end tokens) plus one, or zero if there are no token IDs.
ConstraintState.commit_token: Consumes the input. Returns True if the state is viable after the commit (this does not imply it is accepting); False means the state is dead, not that the commit was rolled back. A dead state is not accepting, is terminated, has an all-zero mask and empty forced bytes, and every later non-empty commit returns False. A dead state can also arise from a grammar whose language is empty. To try input without risking the state, clone it first.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: Consumes the input. Returns True if the state is viable after the commit (this does not imply it is accepting); False means the state is dead, not that the commit was rolled back. A dead state is not accepting, is terminated, has an all-zero mask and empty forced bytes, and every later non-empty commit returns False. A dead state can also arise from a grammar whose language is empty. To try input without risking the state, clone it first. Committing empty bytes leaves the state unchanged and returns whether it is viable.
ConstraintState.forced_bytes: The bytes that must come next.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: Whether the output so far could end here.
ConstraintState.is_terminated: Whether nothing more can be committed.
MaskStrategy: Controls how the constraint is compiled.
Externs: A read-only mapping of extern names to `Extern`.
Extern: A named placeholder in a grammar.
GLRMaskError: The message text is for humans; its format is not stable.
